description: Read OpenVibe.Bot's resource index (ADR-048, plan T13 step 8 phase 2, a person-owned resource): GET /api/v1/resources lists the robots Bot keeps as a page of common.resource-summary@1 (common.resource-list-result@1). Kind bot.robot, id rob_<ULID>, named by the robot's name, owner its owner_subject. Bot holds no projects, so a robot carries no project_id and no OVRN, like Network's user-owned node principals; GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn answers 404 for every name.
